# Quorum

> Quorum is an AI-powered public affairs platform that unifies legislative tracking, grassroots advocacy, stakeholder engagement, and PAC management for government relations professionals.

Quorum serves organizations across federal, state, and local government landscapes, providing integrated tools for policy monitoring, advocacy campaign management, and government contact intelligence. The platform combines real-time legislative intelligence with AI-driven insights to help public affairs teams track bills, engage stakeholders, and measure policy impact.

## Key Topics

## Core Solutions

- [Bill & Legislative Tracking Software | Quorum](https://www.quorum.us/solutions/legislative-tracking): Quorum's legislative tracking solution for Congress, states, and international policy
- [Grassroots Advocacy Software Solutions | Quorum](https://www.quorum.us/solutions/grassroots-advocacy): AI-powered grassroots advocacy platform for supporter engagement and campaign management
- [Stakeholder Management & Engagement Software | Quorum](https://www.quorum.us/solutions/stakeholder-engagement): Stakeholder management CRM for government relations and legislative outreach
- [PAC Management Software | Quorum](https://www.quorum.us/solutions/pac-management-software): AI-powered PAC management with FEC compliance, fundraising, and donation tracking
- [AI for Public Affairs Intelligence | Quorum](https://www.quorum.us/solutions/ai-public-affairs): Quorum AI for legislative intelligence, policy analysis, and content creation

## Intelligence & Monitoring

- [News Monitoring | Quorum Global Media Monitoring](https://www.quorum.us/products/news-monitoring): News monitoring across 75,000 sources with policy intelligence and custom alerts
- [Social Media and Dialogue Tracking | Quorum](https://www.quorum.us/solutions/social-media-tracking): Real-time social media and policy dialogue tracking across platforms
- [Government Contact Data | Quorum](https://www.quorum.us/solutions/government-contact-data): KnowWho government contact database for officials, staff, and policy influencers
- [Visual Reporting Software for Public Affairs | Quorum](https://www.quorum.us/solutions/reporting): Automated visual reporting and dashboards for policy impact measurement
